basic_details.job_title: DUK Data Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology (Digital University Kerala) has one Data Engineer vacancy on a contract basis for its Centre for Digital Transformation & Innovation (CDTI), for an initial period of one year at Rs.30,000/- consolidated per month. Candidates need M.Tech Computer Science or an M.Sc in the listed data and AI subjects with at least two years of experience. Indian citizens can apply online through the university's Recruitment Portal until 10 December 2026.

qualification.details: M.Tech Computer Science/M.Sc (in Artificial Intelligence/Computer Science with Data Analytics/Data Analytics/Statistics with Specialisation in Data Analytics) from a recognized University/Educational Institution.

how_to_apply: Open the application form on the university's Recruitment Portal at https://www.duk.ac.in/careers; the guidelines for submission are available in the portal.
Fill in every relevant field of the online application.
Upload scanned copies of the documents that prove age, qualifications, experience, etc. along with the online application.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 200/-, unless you are an SC/ST/Differently-abled candidate (fee exempted); the mode of payment is available in the recruitment portal.
Submit the application online latest on 10/12/2026.
Scanned copies of documents proving age, qualifications and experience (originals to be produced when called for).

No Objection Certificate from the Head of Office or Department, for candidates in the service of the Government of India or any State Government, to be kept with the candidate and produced when called for.

content_sections.heading: About DUK
content_sections.text: Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology, also called Digital University Kerala, is a university at Technocity Campus, Mangalapuram, Thonnakkal PO, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala - 695 317. This post sits in the university's Centre for Digital Transformation & Innovation (CDTI). The university can be reached at +91-471-2788000 or [email protected] , and its website is www.duk.ac.in .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notification invites applications from qualified Indian citizens. M.Tech Computer Science/M.Sc (in Artificial Intelligence/Computer Science with Data Analytics/Data Analytics/Statistics with Specialisation in Data Analytics) from a recognized University/Educational Institution. Minimum two years in industry/Academic/Govt experience as a Data Engineer / Data Analyst / AI Engineer/ Trainee/Apprentice in related areas. Strong command of the Python language. Familiarity with data analysis libraries and frameworks like Pandas, NumPy, or SciPy. Strong interest in statistics and problem-solving. Experience with SQL/NoSQL for data querying, manipulation, and integration. Knowledge of big data technologies and frameworks (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) for processing and analyzing large-scale datasets. Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP) techniques and text mining. Understanding of cloud-based data storage and analysis platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Familiarity with popular Python frameworks/libraries such as NumPy and pandas (for data analysis), FastAPI, etc. Understanding of Machine Learning (supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, classification, clustering, etc.) and Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch, etc.) concepts. Knowledge of NoSQL platforms (ElasticSearch/MongoDB/CouchBase). The age should not exceed 40 years as of the last date for submission of application. Age relaxation for submission of application is allowed as follows: Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Data Engineer will receive Rs.30,000/- consolidated per month. The appointment is purely on a contract basis for an initial period of one year. The contract may be extended based on the candidate's performance, project requirements, and availability of funds. The appointment does not confer any claim for a regular appointment at the university.

content_sections.heading: DUK Data Engineer Job Description
content_sections.text: As printed in the notification, the Data Engineer will be responsible for: Designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and databases. Collecting, cleaning, and analyzing data. Developing AI/ML-based solutions. Supporting data-driven research and digital transformation initiatives. Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and preparing technical documentation. Ensuring data quality and security, and performing any other project-related tasks assigned by the University/Project Coordinator.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DUK Data Engineer
content_sections.text: Open the application form on the university's Recruitment Portal at https://www.duk.ac.in/careers ; the guidelines for submission are available in the portal. Fill in every relevant field of the online application. Upload scanned copies of the documents that prove age, qualifications, experience, etc. along with the online application. Pay the application fee of Rs. 200/-, unless you are an SC/ST/Differently-abled candidate (fee exempted); the mode of payment is available in the recruitment portal. Submit the application online latest on 10/12/2026. Documents named in the notice: Scanned copies of documents proving age, qualifications and experience (originals to be produced when called for). No Objection Certificate from the Head of Office or Department, for candidates in the service of the Government of India or any State Government, to be kept with the candidate and produced when called for.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a test and an interview. The test/interview will be conducted in Thiruvananthapuram district only. The schedule of the test/interview will be sent to candidates through their registered email only, so applicants should check their registered e-mails regularly after 10 December 2026. The selection/appointment will be provisional and subject to physical verification of the documents.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DUK Recruitment 2026 for Data Engineer?
faq.answer: There is one Data Engineer vacancy (Job Code DE/112026/23) at the Centre for Digital Transformation & Innovation (CDTI).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DUK Data Engineer post?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted latest on 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the DUK Data Engineer post?
faq.answer: M.Tech Computer Science/M.Sc (in Artificial Intelligence/Computer Science with Data Analytics/Data Analytics/Statistics with Specialisation in Data Analytics) from a recognized University/Educational Institution, plus minimum two years of experience as a Data Engineer / Data Analyst / AI Engineer/ Trainee/Apprentice in related areas.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DUK Data Engineer post?
faq.answer: The age should not exceed 40 years as of the last date for submission of application, with 5 years' relaxation for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a DUK Data Engineer?
faq.answer: The post carries Rs.30,000/- consolidated per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 200/-, and the fee is exempted for SC/ST/Differently-abled candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the DUK Data Engineer post?
faq.answer: Apply online through the Recruitment Portal at https://www.duk.ac.in/careers, uploading scanned documents proving age, qualifications and experience, by 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How will the Data Engineer be selected?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on a test and an interview held in Thiruvananthapuram district only, with the schedule sent to the registered email.

faq.question: Q9. Is the DUK Data Engineer job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely on contract for an initial one year, may be extended based on performance, project requirements and availability of funds, and confers no claim for a regular appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Do government employees need an NOC to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates in the service of the Government of India or any State Government should obtain a No Objection Certificate from their Head of Office or Department and produce it when called for.
